text:
lina: deploy-bot blocked the release — preflight shows an env key parity mismatch for the model router. staging has MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL_S3, prod expects MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL. deploybot log: 'parity-fail: key mismatch (staging->MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL_S3, prod->MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL)'. can someone confirm the origin?

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Release paused by policy - env key parity failed (key 'MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL'). Affected services: inference-router, batch-importer. Preflight report: /deploy/reports/1719829999.

omar: on it. quick question — which PR touched the sentinel var?

lina: PR #4728 (feature/faststart) did a rename to standardize names. The kube secret rotation earlier today seems to have applied only to staging via legacy-secret-sync. prod still has the inline key.

sophie: we shouldn't hotpatch prod. two safe paths: 1) backfill prod keystore with the staging key (ops run one-off sync) or 2) pin this release to the previous model-variant while we fix automation. backfill is faster.

infra-bot: Secrets sync job "secret-sync-legacy" finished at 03:12 UTC, applied only to namespace 'staging'. Prod sync skipped due to tag 's3-read-only' on prod-keystore.

ryan: If ops can't/shouldn't touch prod right now, we can also add a short-lived fallback in the config: read MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL || MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL_S3. small risk but buys time for proper fix.

omar: I can prepare a canary image with the fallback config and smoke it against canary infra. parsing change is tiny but will run unit+integration locally.

lina: prefer not to push code change during the release. Sophie — can you request ops to run a one-off secret-sync to prod? tagging @ops in case they missed this thread.

sophie: @ops can we run a one-off secret-sync to prod keystore? This release is blocked. It's the same payload as staging; low-risk. If we have a change window, we can do it immediately.

alex: ack — ops will run a one-off secret-sync to prod within the change window. starting in ~6m. will post status and add note to release doc.

infra-bot: One-off secret-sync started at 1719830400. Applying keys: MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL -> <redacted>. No service restarts expected.

infra-bot: One-off secret-sync completed at 1719830580. Verified key MODEL_ROUTER_SENTINEL present in prod namespace 'inference'.

deploy-bot: Preflight re-run: env parity check PASSED. Release can proceed. To continue: run
```
/release continue 1719829999
```

lina: thanks all. i'll resume the rollout after the window. note for follow-up: fix secret-sync automation to not skip prod when 's3-read-only' tag is present, and add a retention test to release preflight.

ryan: :thumbsup: i'll also add a 24h fallback in config to tolerate propagation lag, then remove it in next minor after confirming.

lina: filing a short postmortem action item list now.
